name: 涂淑惠
objective:
1. 二極體電路分析與設計 2. 電晶體電路分析與設計 3. FET 電路分析與設計 4. 放大器頻率響應分析及頻率補償 5. 功率放大器分析與設計 6. 回授放大器分析與設計 7. 差動及運算放大器分析與設計 8. 震盪器分析與設計 9. 主動濾波器分析與設計
1. Diode circuit Analysis and Design2. Transistor circuit Analysis and Design3. Transistor circuit Analysis and Design4. FET circuit Analysis and Design5. Amplifier Frequency response Analysis and Componstaion6. Power Amplifier Analysis and Design7. Feedback Amplifier Analysis and Design8. Differential and Operational Amplifier Analysis and Design9. Oscillator Analysis and Design10. Active Filter Analysis and Design
課程進度(1-16週):
Weeks 1-3 Transistor circuit Analysis and Design (電晶體電路分析與設計)
Weeks 4-5 Cascode stage and Current Mirrors (疊接電路與電流鏡) 
Weeks 6-8 Analysis and Design of Differential Amplifiers (差動放大器分析與設計)
Week 9 Midterm exam (期中考試)
Weeks 10-11 Frequency Response of Amplifiers (放大器頻率響應)
Weeks 11-13 Noise and Feedback (雜訊和回授)
Weeks 13-14 Operational Amplifiers (運算放大器分析與設計)
Weeks 14-15 Stability and Frequency Compensation (穩定度和頻率補償)
Week 16 Final exam (期末考試)
Weeks 17-18 Flexible learning (彈性學習)
彈性學習(17-18週):
類別
		  
		    ● 參與課程相關作業、作品、實驗、田野調查 (Participation in course-related assignments, works, experiments, or field research)

          Week 17 Analytical Synthesis of Oscillators / Filters
Week 18 Bandgap References
